events.description: Initialize and display the 2x2 layout of four complex planes with the nested square grid on Plane A.
events.clip_query: A 2x2 grid of coordinate planes with a nested square grid on the top-left plane.

events.description: Animate the mapping of the nested grid from Plane A to Plane B using the complex logarithm function.
events.clip_query: The nested square grid transforms into parallel lines on the top-right plane via a logarithmic mapping.

events.description: Animate the linear transformation (rotation and scaling) of the grid from Plane B to Plane C.
events.clip_query: The grid of parallel lines rotates and scales as it moves to the bottom-left plane.

events.description: Animate the exponential mapping from Plane C to Plane D, wrapping the grid into a spiral Droste pattern.
events.clip_query: The rotated grid wraps into a spiral pattern on the bottom-right plane with a glowing center.
